scientific_integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by an explicit complete face-poset matching and direct acyclicity verification; mod-2 chain ranks are an independent corroborating computation.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite computation for the Heawood graph and total 3-cut complex only; no family-level theorem is claimed. An unindexed duplicate remains a bibliographic risk.
title: The total \(3\)-cut complex of the Heawood graph is a wedge of \(36\) eight-spheres
